description: A night scene at an outdoor stadium or plaza. Fireworks burst in the upper left and floodlights glare from both sides through haze. In the right foreground a uniformed man in a dark peaked cap and dark tunic with a belt stands on a platform, seen from behind, hauling a large flag up a tall pole. The flag is blue, red and green with white edging and a gold sun. A crowd fills the lower foreground, arms raised and waving small flags of the same design. On a raised stage in the middle distance a row of men in dark suits and a few women stand in a line by a microphone. No readable letters or numbers are visible, and the painting runs edge to edge with no frame.
